summary: Revised Parallax publication setup document grounded in shipped content evidence (Edition 01: The Manifesto, Edition 02: The Coachella Reckoning). Implements Path 1 (Identity > Niche) from the Sinem audit. Rewrites the Three Questions positioning lock to center Parallax as Farrice's mind garden — the philosophical layer beneath his professional work — rather than a consulting funnel. Updates the Hero Post outline, Navigation Design, and Welcome Email to match the voice and tone established in published editions. Eliminates references to $10k consulting as the explicit conversion mechanism and replaces with organic trust-building that makes professional engagement a natural consequence, not a stated destination. Includes the creative rebrief's visual identity direction (typographic minimalism, violet L wordmark, Canva-built assets) and the about page copy from the Sinem workflow.
